title: Tax break for affordable co-ops on Convent Avenue, Manhattan
summary: The Council approved a 40-year property tax exemption under Article XI of the Private Housing Finance Law for four buildings at 48-50 Convent Avenue, 453-455 West 125th Street and 12-14 Old Broadway in Manhattanville. The exemption supports an HPD Affordable Neighborhood Cooperative Program project that will renovate the buildings into about 75 affordable cooperative housing units. The exemption can end early if the property is not operated according to program rules.
